card.name: History and museum words in web pages
card.fires_on: The word History or Historical, or a small word right after it or after a museum or society name, in web-page titles, menus and credits. Also fires on a few words like end, save or to about causes or campaigns.

modes.label: History titles
modes.description: The word History, Historical, or the 'of' after History in headings, menus and credits.
modes.example: MUSEUM STORE >BE A PATRON >SEE CAP HISTORY LOCALLY| © 2005-2009, CAP<< Historical>> Foundation. All rights reserved. No reproduction

modes.label: Museum or society wording
modes.description: A small word after a museum or historical society name, such as 'home of' or 'save'.
modes.example: Beth Ahabah is the home<< of>> the Beth Ahabah Museum & Archives

modes.label: Ending a cause
modes.description: Verbs or 'to' in phrases about ending or saving something in campaign text.
modes.example: wants to<< end>> the injustice that perpetuates the cycle of
